text: GM reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $3.70 and revenue of $50.02B, both above estimates. Full-year adjusted EPS guidance narrowed to $12.75-$13.75, with automotive free cash flow raised to $11.5B-$12.5B. GM announced a $20B buyback; shares fell roughly 6%.

meta.note: Quarterly earnings outperformance and full-year guidance expectations reflect different comparison bases.
